text:
ConocoPhillips edged up 0.33% today as oil prices stabilized following news of renewed U.S.-Iran peace negotiations, which eased concerns about potential Middle East supply disruptions. The stock has climbed 5.52% over two weeks as global crude has remained elevated (world oil at $123/barrel), supporting earnings expectations for energy companies heading into reporting season.

The modest gain today reflects caution in the market despite strong fundamentals — CNBC noted that while Big Oil earnings are set to surge, investors may want to be cautious, suggesting the market is already pricing in much of the upside from higher oil prices. With geopolitical risk temporarily receding, the focus is shifting to what companies will actually guide investors on for the future rather than just riding the current price environment.
